title: Christopher Nolan's Next Movie Has Zendaya, Tom Holland, Matt Damon and Anne Hathaway — and No One Will Say What It's About
metaDescription: Christopher Nolan has assembled Zendaya, Tom Holland, Matt Damon and Anne Hathaway for his next film — and insiders say every rumored plot leaked so far is wrong.
altText: Movies news illustration for: Christopher Nolan's Next Movie Has Zendaya, Tom Holland, Matt Damon and Anne Hathaway — and No One Will Say What It's About
html:
Christopher Nolan has one of the most stacked casts of his career for his next project — and almost nobody outside his inner circle knows what the movie is actually about.

Confirmed so far: Zendaya, Tom Holland, Matt Damon, and Anne Hathaway. For Hathaway and Damon, it's a reunion of sorts — both have worked with Nolan before, on "The Dark Knight Rises" and "Interstellar" respectively. For Zendaya and Holland, it's their first time working with the director at all.

It's also notable that Zendaya and Holland — a real-life couple since meeting on the set of the "Spider-Man" franchise — will be sharing a Nolan project together for the first time. Neither has publicly commented on what it means to take on a project this secretive as a couple, but it adds an extra layer of interest to a cast that was already generating headlines on its own.

As for the plot: nothing official has been confirmed, and according to sources close to the production, that's by design. The article that first surfaced the casting news specifically noted that "sources say that loglines or descriptions of the film that have been published to date are wrong" — meaning every guess currently circulating, including theories ranging from a period vampire story to a spy thriller to a father-son drama, should be treated as speculation rather than fact.

Filming was expected to begin in early 2025, with no confirmed release date, studio details, or title announced as of this writing. Given Nolan's track record of guarding his projects until the last possible moment, fans may be waiting a while before any of these rumors get confirmed — or shut down entirely.
